mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotions (code, name, type, value, buy_qty, get_qty, min_qty, product_id, category_id, store_id, coupon_code, starts_at, ends_at, active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{value}, #{buyQty}, #{getQty}, #{minQty}, #{productId}, #{categoryId}, #{storeId}, #{couponCode}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{active})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM promotions ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM promotions WHERE active = TRUE AND (starts_at IS NULL OR starts_at <= now()) AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > now())
